creator: Alexander Terp
description:
MIP-10 stage 2, part 3 of 3: acting on panes. Read docs/mip/0010-api-for-other-tools.md section 5.

What: make a pane that runs a command in a directory, on this machine, as a helper of a pane or not (`muster pane new --run`), with an operation id; type into a pane with the `--confirm` read-back (`muster pane send`), never retried for the client, an input of unknown fate reported as unknown; close a pane; compact and restart its agent. Each runs the same daemon code the CLI reaches with no window open (crates/muster-cli/src/windowless.rs and the daemon's handlers), so the API and the CLI cannot drift.

Proves: a gate test client starts a shell pane, types into it and reads the confirmation, closes it; a retried pane creation with the same operation id makes one pane.
title: MIP-10 stage 2c: making, typing into and closing panes through the API
